page.overview:
Who is Brigitte Borbeau?

Brigitte Borbeau is a fictional French intelligence operative. The character appeared in the 2015 video-game James Bond: World of Espionage. Borbeau is loosely based on the literary character Elizabeth Krest, who was featured in the Ian Fleming's short story, "The Hildebrand Rarity". The character is portrayed by the Brazilian actress Ana Flavia Gavlak.

Lurching from one disastrous relationship to another, Brigitte reported the death of her first husband on a cruise in the Indian Ocean as an accident (apparently, he cut himself shaving). Having gathered a taste for blood and money, she now plays method actor on the yachts of the most foul men imaginable, biding her time to gather evidence needed to ensure their conviction. Failing that, she is only too happy to give them a close shave with her hand-crafted, spring-loaded straight razor.

A misanthrope, she is skilled in swimming, hand-to-hand combat and finance, and is multi-lingual, speaking French, English, Italian and Hebrew. The character offers increased money from facilities and provides a 1% chance to receive no damage using pen-knives and a 2% chance to receive no damage using private jets. She is an 'uncommon agent' (green) and can be levelled to level 15.
